issues.reason: Measures & units states that a scale no word supplies is never invented and takes the reserved slot symbol `unspecified`; no word here names a dimension ('measures' is not a dimension-naming verb the way weighs->weight or costs->price is — the time reading comes only from knowing what a watch is), and `duration`, defined for an eventuality's own extent, additionally makes the atom read as the sand-glass itself lasting one watch, which the sentence does not state.

gaps_confirmed: A measuring instrument's calibrated extent ('the sand-glass measures one watch') has no licensed carrier: the Measure head predicates the magnitude of the BEARER, and (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) is defined for an eventuality's own extent — neither expresses 'marks out an interval of N units'.
defect_summary: The nearest compliant form is (Measure sk_sandglass_1 unspecified 1 watch), the reserved symbol for an unstated dimension, but even that attributes the one-watch extent to the sand-glass rather than to the interval it marks out, so the instruction set licenses NO fully compliant form for the instrument reading — the confirmed gap.
notes: Everything else tracks the words: the definite singular as a witness, (Inheritance sand_glass glass) as the compound genus with the noun modifier left inside the symbol, magnitude 1 and unit watch taken from the surface, and no status atom on the habitual present.
